cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app')
from language import load, validate, MAX_BYTES, MAX_NODES, MAX_DEPTH
from checker import check
from interpreter import run
from evaluate import evaluate

text = open('/app/witness.json').read()
print("file bytes:", len(text.encode('utf-8')), "<= 65536:", len(text.encode('utf-8'))<=MAX_BYTES)
p = load(text)
nodes = validate(p)
print("AST nodes:", nodes, "<= 512:", nodes<=MAX_NODES)
print("body statements:", len(p['body']), "<= 128:", len(p['body'])<=128)
print("cells:", len(p['cells']), "inputs:", len(p['inputs']))
# determinism / repeat runs
outs = set()
for _ in range(5):
    r = evaluate(text)
    outs.add((r['accepted'], r['status'], r['message'], r['steps']))
print("5 runs identical:", outs)
print("outcome:", outs.pop())
EOF
